## The notation

What you write, and where PHPStan or Psalm documents it.

```php

```

## What it should resolve to

The type PHPStan or Psalm infers. If you are unsure, `PHPStan\dumpType($value)`
prints it.

## What happens now

Nothing, a coarser type, or something wrong.
